g.text: Demo tier LLD — the same contracts on scale-to-zero services
ACCEPTED DESIGN · ADR-0015 with the ADR-0010 and ADR-0013 amendments · conditional writes replace row locks; TTL replaces eviction; every switch-over passes a gate first
jobs pk job_id state · attempt (fence) · lease_until · deadline
job_events pk job_id, sk seq ttl 30 d (replay after Last-Event-ID)
sessions pk session_id ttl 24 h guest · 8 h admin
quotas pk scope#window atomic ADD, ttl = window end
cache pk <ADR-0013 key string> ttl per key type · locks too
wake_ledger pk day, sk window_start 45 min/day cap (ADR-0014)
checkpoints PK, SK (DynamoDBSaver) ttl 7 d · > 350 KB → S3
stream on jobs (INSERT) → dispatcher → SQS: the outbox without a table
past deadline ⇒ failed on the next read (lazy, no sweeper)
CONDITIONAL WRITES · how DynamoDB keeps the ADR-0013 contracts
Put idempotency IF attribute_not_exists(pk) # else same hash → same job, else 409
Put jobs(queued, attempt 0) · Put job_events seq 1 ]
claim UpdateItem jobs SET attempt = attempt + 1, state = running
IF state = queued OR (state = running AND lease_until < :now)
commit Transact [ConditionCheck jobs: state = running AND attempt = :mine,
expire SET state = failed, attempt = attempt + 1 IF lease_until < :now
lock Put lock:memo:… IF attribute_not_exists(pk) OR expires_at < :now
quota ADD n 1 IF attribute_not_exists(n) OR n < :limit
cache keys unchanged (ev: · qe: · rr: · memo:) · read error ⇒ run cold
POST _aliases # one atomic call; polls _count first
ACCESS · guest for recruiters, Cognito for the admin (ADR-0010 amendment)
admin: Cognito issuer, group admin, MFA
browser holds only an HttpOnly session cookie;
SWITCH-OVER GATES · nothing is enabled until its gate passes (ADR-0009 amendment, ADR-0011)
